dreamteamer.title: macOS connector
dreamteamer.description: Reaches Apple Voice Memos for `recordings` on a Mac: `npx dt-voice-memos` copies each new memo into the first `INBOX_FOLDERS` root's `meeting-recordings/`, so `/process-new-meetings` imports, matches and transcribes it. One small helper, started as a launchd job, holds the Full Disk Access grant. The `importing-voice-memos` skill runs it before the pipeline.
